partial_claims: The removal and installation of vehicle batteries in the HMMWV (M998-series) follow a standard procedure to ensure safety and proper function.
Turn off the vehicle and remove the key.
Disconnect the negative terminal (black cable) first, followed by the positive terminal (red cable), to prevent short circuits.
Loosen and remove the battery hold-down clamp or bracket securing the battery to the chassis.
Carefully lift the battery out of the battery tray.
Place the new battery into the tray, ensuring it is properly aligned.
Secure the battery using the hold-down clamp or bracket, tightening it to the manufacturer’s specified torque.
Connect the positive terminal (red cable) first, then the negative terminal (black cable), ensuring clean, tight connections.
Verify that all connections are secure and free of corrosion.
This procedure ensures safe handling and proper electrical connection.
While specific torque values or exact steps may vary
the general sequence is consistent with standard military vehicle maintenance practices for the HMMWV.
